text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Ouch ouch ouch! Ugh, what a catastrophe! 
Could it be...?"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: To think I took an arrow to the knee!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
No, it was just a figure of speech. I only 
twisted my leg a little, but...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I suppose running the grueling Tenno Sho 
(Spring) with these legs truly is 
impossible after all. How vexing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She gave up on the Tenno Sho (Spring), 
which she had been considering entering...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to entrust the battle for the 
Shield to Hishi Miracle and Dants Flame.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Look, look, Dantsu-chan. That 
bulletin board...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Mirako-senpai? What on 
earth happened...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Our popularity... After trying so hard, 
is this really all we get?"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mirako's the 7th favorite, and Lady Dantsu 
is the 9th favorite~?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"What's this? There are hardly any 
formidable rivals, yet no one expects 
anything from me."
choice_data_list: Well, based on my recent record...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Far from being unbeatable, they often 
suffered major collapses. With this kind 
of inconsistency, it couldn't be helped, 
but...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, to think I'd be underestimated. 
Still, it works out just fine.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mirako! Dantsu! Neither Kris S nor Tap are 
here today!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The stage is set to overthrow the top!! 
Show 'em what you're made of!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"No Reason-chan... That's right... Today's 
my chance!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, Dantsu-chan! Let's show 
everyone our very best!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes... You're right! I won't give up 
before I've even tried!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle & Dantsu
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaah! Taaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame moves up to second! But here 
comes Hishi Miracle from the outside! 
Hishi Miracle--!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle has done it――!! A massive 
upset from the 7th favorite――!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame also moved up to second at 
one point and put up a good fight, 
finishing 5th!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: W-W-Wooooooh!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mirako-o-o-o!! Splendid, absolutely 
splendid work-k-k!! Unyaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason rejoiced as if it were his own 
victory. Cherry blossoms of jubilation 
danced over Yodo.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, confidence... I never really had 
any. Not running out of steam is my only 
real strength, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I think it's only because it was this 
distance that I somehow managed to catch 
up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle looked happy the entire time 
she was in the winner's circle.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"No Reason-chan, I did it! It was a 
long-distance race, my specialty, so I 
somehow managed to pull through~."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Aye, I saw it! I saw it indeed, Mirako~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I was so overjoyed that I practically 
danced a little jig!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Mirako-senpai... Ugh, that's so 
frustrating!! Even I genuinely thought, 
"I've got this!!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "It is truly... frustrating. However..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Watching you give it your all gave me 
courage too. Congratulations, 
Mirako-senpai.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, Lady Dants. You gave us quite the 
show as well! It was truly splendid.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So, what do you want to do? Since we have 
the chance, want to say something to the 
people who cheered for you?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Let us sound our victory cry 
with great fanfare!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hear ye, everyone!! I thank you deeply for 
cheering on my comrades today!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
And next is finally the greatest battle of 
this spring. Namely—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: It's the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Next time won't be as easy as today. A 
lineup of prominent warlords will be 
waiting!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Forget victory; even a decent run won't 
come easy. Even so—"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Why should the three of us flinch!? Our 
opponents are Umamusume born under the 
very same sky!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Shall we not show them?! The Underdog 
Alliance's grand, once-in-a-lifetime 
performance!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fans went wild over No Reason's 
theatrical speech. However...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, medium distance does seem pretty 
tough, though...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
To recapture that day's brilliance once 
more…… I'd love to do something about it, 
but……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Their expressions look grim. Even so—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Not a chance! If you wish for it strongly 
enough, how could anything be impossible?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hear ye, everyone, stay tuned and look 
forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The countdown to the spring decisive 
battle has begun. At the Takarazuka Kinen, 
the Gekokujo Alliance will challenge the 
strongest force.
